Container.Name: OpenClaw
Container.Overview: OpenClaw personal AI assistant Gateway. Requires first-time onboarding and a Gateway token. Configuration and workspace data persist in the mapped appdata directory.

Config.Name: Gateway WebUI/API
Config.Description: OpenClaw Gateway HTTP and WebSocket port

Config.Name: OpenClaw Config and Workspace
Config.Description: Persistent OpenClaw configuration, credentials, sessions, and workspace

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND
Config.Description: Bind Gateway to the Docker network so Unraid can reach the published port

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT
Config.Description: Gateway listen port inside the container

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_SKIP_SERVICE_CHECK
Config.Description: Skip native service checks in the container
